svg.aria-label: An illustrative gimorra scan of checkout.acme.test, in six scenes: the scope guard admits three hosts and strikes out the denied one, every recon pass unions onto one attack-surface table, a master agent dispatches four specialist children, probers hunt four asserted premises and refute two, the proof engine re-proves eleven proposed PoCs and keeps three while rejecting eight, and the run comes back as one folder with the reproduced findings.

g.text: hunt auth bypasses on checkout, leave admin alone
arsenal · every child pinned to it

text.tspan: 11 PoCs proposed · handed to the proof engine

g.text: replaying 11 PoCs with the least-invasive request each
the validator could not reproduce it

text.tspan: · each child a durable queue row
a lead, or a clean refutation

svg.text: Autonomous offensive security, bought with deterministic guardrails.
